book.name: Apanll Chtarangu
book.title: Apanll chtarangu anu Apanll chtakchuri ashirangu anu

content: Ashiri botee ichingaru iwaparamchu, Apanllsha Nowerineetsi: Shiya misha ipartamtish wizanllpatari zarungtsa. Ashiri nuw siyaa tapachindachintspa. ¿Chakaja shiyapa tatsamooch? Siyamari wanasirtischa. Shiy wanasir taamaam chinarangsa, tárangiya Apanlli.

Nimun tsimbun matayaru zari sinaa zanganchima. Sin sinasintar ashku 40 zar taachiya. Ashiri wanasir mazinangcha. Yuw maachi ichingarusin taakana anoo yamangcha. Itaru, zamzimari upapchiri 7 yamangcha; misha wizarsha sietitam yamangtamcha ayam tsapurunasish pzapaneemaama. Mishat, manginshucheetssha mantsamoo upapchir minamtam wizar minamtam ashiru yamangcha. Yuw katuchkachu anoo izuuru tpachingachima ichingaru tputspatatamta, Nowee tárangiya Apanlli.
Nowerinsha, Ayu tárangiya yuwaa Apanll kamachtarangu anootsi.
Yuwapur sin sinamaam chtarangu anpur Nowerini 600 masachirini taarangiya.
Chiynaa kamungachpachee, tárangusin, wipapat, wizanllpatatam, wipaptatam wizanll ashirusin ichingarusin zaruranganaya.
Maacheetsi ichingaru izarurangiya. Zamzee, purangtaru anootstam, pshiyrataru tsapushu anootstam, ichingaru tsapurunasish taakana; manginshuchi anoo tapshturangiya.
Upapchir, wizar ashirusin kusatarangusin, Nowepat washunand zaruranganaya, watam Apanll waana kamachtaranguwa.
Zaruramchusin, anumun tsimbun matayaru zari tushiyramchu, anush tsapurunasee tayutaritamaam chtarangiya.

Nowerini 600 masachirini taarangiya. Anumunsha tsimbun tsupi tushiyramchu, kanindamand sin kapung zaw zaw ashirangu, tsapushsha kazupeeru anush kung kapungtam zaw zaw ashitangattamta. Ichingaru zar psaanpatari putam putam ashiru sinarangiya. 40 zar sinarangiya. Nda pastarangiya.
Kaapa nuwaa kuki mazinangtsa. Anpur zar ndatuma sin sinaru, Nowerini botirinshini zaruranganaya. Ichingaru wip ashparta Simo, Kamu, Hapeta, wip wizanlli tuchparitamsina zaruranganaya.
Sheersin, maachitpatari washunand yapatarsin, zamzitam, manginshuchtam, chinuztam, yuwatam tsapumun pshiyrataru anutam zaruranganaya.

Ashirusin, washunandari maachi ichingaru upapchir wizarpatari tsimbun tsimbun ashirusin botish zaruranganaya. Nowerini yuwari Apanll kamachtarangu anooritam tuminurangiya. Ashiramchu, ichingaru maachi zarum yuwaparamchu, Apanllsha waana wachoo mbam shtandayaru kasarangiya.
Kizpuri ichingaru zar sinasintar ashirangiya. 40 zar kaschiritam psaanpatari sinarangiya. ¡Maya! tsapoo ichingaroo purangiya. Botsha pamuzingarangiya.
¿Mayaatseeja nda puch? Ichingaru purangiya. Itaru, botsha muziztar ashirangiya.
Kizpur kung kumbiyrangu, ichingaroo macheewa yuwaatstaa kizpur íwar anoowaatstaa purangiya.
Ashirangu anumunsha, kung wandari aranginasha machee kuwiz arangich tsimbun matayaru metor kánuru purangiya.
Ashiriya, ichingaru manginshuch tsiparanganaya. Izuuru maachee pchingaranganaya.
Yuw tsapush maachi zamiz ichingaru taakana an, misha mantsamtam ichingaru kungumun tsiparanganaya. Minamtiyam nda kchitarangiya. Tputstam ichingarusin pchingaranganaya.
Maachi ichingaru kchitamuntaa taarangu, ashiritaa Apanll waana izuuru tpachingarangiya kungupta. Itaru, Nowerinchichimari tputs botosh ichingarusin kamungaranganaya.
Kungsha watam tsapurunasee zameetpat tsup izuuru puru taarangiya.
